escalation.obstacle: Decide whether any of the 1145 surviving equal-signature classes of G_rep contains a pair forced equal at k=5. A confirmed forced pair would give an explicit 6-chromatic unit-distance graph via the geometry branch's amplifier; it would simplify the analytic proof but would not be a new 6-versus-7 bound.
escalation.definitions: A unit-distance graph is a finite graph with an injection into R^2 such that uv is an edge iff |u-v| = 1. Proper k-colouring: c(u) != c(v) on every edge. A pair is forced equal at k if G is k-colourable and G plus the edge pq is not; the added edge is a combinatorial disequality constraint, never a unit edge for a non-adjacent pair. G_rep is the graph on the 1048 reported points with the 5487 reported edges; H is the frozen 553-vertex Heule graph, induced inside G_rep.
